summary: Andretti Acquisition Corp. II, a SPAC, filed an 8-K disclosing entry into new non-redemption agreements. The company extended its extraordinary general meeting to September 8, 2026, to allow additional redemptions and reversals. Under the agreements with unaffiliated holders of Class A shares, the sponsor will cause the post-business-combination entity to issue up to 650,000 ordinary shares (plus prior 250,000, and 83,333 if after June 9, 2027) in exchange for investors agreeing not to redeem up to an aggregate of 1,000,000 public shares. No price per share or premium is stated. This is a standard SPAC redemption-reduction tactic, not a standalone event class; watch shareholder vote and extension outcome.
